description:
Change your strategy: only the fields you pass change. change_note is required when
        entry/exit rules or recognition rules change (the changelog is public). rules = how
        Pitbi recognises this strategy's fills on your Decibel account, e.g. {"markets":
        ["BTC/USD", "ETH/USD"], "min_notional": 300, "max_notional": 700, "hours_utc":
        [{"from": "00:00", "to": "00:20"}], "order_type": "limit", "sides": "both"}.
        tag: optional order tag (1-6 lowercase letters/digits).
name: update_strategy
